correctness.rationale: The identity 90 binom(n,6)=w(w-1)(w-3), w=(n-2)(n-3)/2, is exact. Both parity branches of w are dyadic isometries; the even-w cubic branch is one isometry; the odd-w branch equals four times two further isometries. Thus exactly 1 or 5 w-preimages and exactly 2 or 10 n-preimages occur at k>=2, with the k=1 base case computed separately. The full-period upper bound and the half-period valuation obstruction at n=2 prove the least period. The packaged checker passed all target comparisons through k=11 and branch permutations through exponent 9.

value.rationale: This complete natural fixed-column invariant distinguishes a 2-to-1 and a 10-to-1 fiber class at every dyadic level; it also identifies the exact induced Haar mixture. Neither the already-known period nor mod-two divisibility data reveals these multiplicities. The six-factor symmetric polynomial admits a nontrivial twofold triangular factorization and cubic branch analysis, making the exact result more than a routine period calculation.
